## Market-defining technologies driving the future of AI

Cloud Control AgenticOps AI networking Silicon One Hybrid Mesh Firewall Smart Switches Unified Edge
Cisco IQ
[Cisco Cloud Control software screenshot]

### Cisco Cloud Control

The unified platform with one shared view across every IT domain.

[Discover Cisco Cloud Control][29]
[AI Canvas London Network Troubleshooting results]

### Enterprise operations at agentic AI speed

Move beyond visibility to autonomous operations with trusted, policy-bound agents that execute
complex workflows at machine speed—while humans govern intent, policy, and risk.

[Discover AI Canvas][30]
[AI networking]

### Resilient, high-speed AI networking

AI-optimized networking that unifies scale, speed, and resilience—so AI workloads run faster, more
efficiently, and at global scale.

[See what's new][31]
[Cisco Silicon One processor on a circuit board in shades of blue and grey]

### Silicon to power AI-scale networking

Purpose-built programmable silicon powers networks with leading performance, efficiency, and scale –
optimized for AI workloads across hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers.

[Explore Silicon One][32]
[Sunset over a city skyline with a dense network of glowing lights across the foreground]

### Distributed, optimized enforcement

Deliver zero-trust segmentation and application protection with a highly-distributed security fabric
and unified management across data center, cloud, campus, and IoT environments.

[Explore Hybrid Mesh Firewall][33]
[Close-up of networking equipment with multiple ports and visible Cisco logo]

### Security fused into the network

Security is embedded at every layer of the network, scaling to support any AI application while
simplifying even the most sophisticated campus and enterprise environment.

[Learn about Smart Switches][34]
[Close-up of networking equipment featuring Ethernet ports, status LEDs, and network icons]

### The AI-ready platform the edge demands

Redefine edge computing with a full-stack platform that delivers data center performance,
modularity, centralized management, and built-in security where you need it most.

[See the future of the edge][35]
[Cisco IQ Assets Overview dashboard featuring a total assets count, coverage percentage, and AI
Assistant messages]

### Cisco IQ

Cisco IQ is the unified AI-powered experience that delivers real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance to power Cisco support and
professional services.

[Learn about Cisco IQ][36]
[glow background]

## Powering outcomes you need to thrive in the AI era

### AI-ready data centers

Modernize and transform your data centers to power traditional and AI workloads anywhere—with speed,
scale, and flexibility.

[Glowing translucent cubes with internal circuitry connected by blue light beams.]

Create agile, resilient workplaces that evolve with employee needs and deliver incredible customer

For over a century, we’ve tackled the most pressing challenges in industries where failure has real
consequences: In refineries, hospitals, data centers, buildings and manufacturing plants.
[A construction worker wearing a safety vest and helmet ascends a spiral staircase, emphasizing

harness the intelligence inside them, turning individual assets into synchronized systems that
continuously learn, adapt — and amplify human potential.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.

# Wind technology powering tomorrow's energy systems

Siemens Gamesa is a global leader in wind energy, supporting companies and countries worldwide in
building resilient, affordable, and sustainable energy systems that accelerate the energy
transition.

[ [icon] Explore products and services ][28]
[Omterra logo following the announcement of the rebrand from Siemens Gamesa and Siemens Energy.]
Siemens Gamesa and Siemens Energy will become Omterra
Same team, same commitment – a new brand. Driven by our purpose to energize society, our strategy,
and our values.
[ Read our official announcement ][29]
1. Onshore
2. Offshore
3. Service

Your trusted technology partner

#### Onshore

Operating in 81 countries, Siemens Gamesa offers an extensive range of onshore wind turbine
technologies to cover all wind classes and site conditions. By listening to our customers - and
backed up by over 40 years of experience - we know just what it takes to develop and manage a
successful onshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][30]

Powerful performance

#### Offshore

Leading the way forward, our engineers and technicians pioneered the offshore sector back in 1991,
with the world’s first wind power plant in Denmark. Since then, Siemens Gamesa has grown to become
the global leader in offshore power generation. Offering full-scope solutions and services, our
people and products will guarantee the success of your next offshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][31]

World-class maintenance

#### Service

Siemens Gamesa has a proven track record of excellence in operation and maintenance. Leveraging
scale and global reach, we offer a flexible service portfolio that can be tailored to our customers’
diverse operating models. We also provide advanced diagnostics and digitalization capabilities, as
well as customized offshore offerings.

[
[icon]
Read more ][32]

**Career**

#### Passionate about renewables

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy
for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters.

[ Join the team at Siemens Gamesa ][33]

**Sustainability**

#### Delivering sustainability through actions

This decade will be judged on our ability to take the steps needed to keep global temperature rises
this century to between 1.5 and 2.0 degrees Celsius, as well as deliver a fairer and more equal
world. That is why as part of our Sustainability Vision 2040, we are focused not just on the targets
we set, but instead on the actions that are needed to deliver on them.

[ More information ][34]
[Siemens Gamesa SG 15-236 offshore wind turbine installation]

### The next milestone on Siemens Gamesa's industrialization journey: SG 15-236

Offshore wind is entering a new era—one defined by scale, standardization, and technology-proven
reliability. With the introduction of the SG 15-236, Siemens Gamesa marks the next major step in the
industrialization of offshore wind energy.

 
* [ Read more ][35]

### Sustainability: From nice-to-have to prerequisite for winning

In popular culture, wind turbines often serve as a type of visual shorthand for the dream of a
sustainable future. But in the real world, sustainability considerations have evolved into strategic
drivers and enablers for our company and customers in Siemens Gamesa.
* [ Read more ][36]

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy
for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters.

[ Join the team at Siemens Gamesa ][33]

**Sustainability**

#### Delivering sustainability through actions

This decade will be judged on our ability to take the steps needed to keep global temperature rises
this century to between 1.5 and 2.0 degrees Celsius, as well as deliver a fairer and more equal
world. That is why as part of our Sustainability Vision 2040, we are focused not just on the targets
we set, but instead on the actions that are needed to deliver on them.

[ More information ][34]
[Siemens Gamesa SG 15-236 offshore wind turbine installation]

### The next milestone on Siemens Gamesa's industrialization journey: SG 15-236

Offshore wind is entering a new era—one defined by scale, standardization, and technology-proven
reliability. With the introduction of the SG 15-236, Siemens Gamesa marks the next major step in the
industrialization of offshore wind energy.

 
* [ Read more ][35]

### Sustainability: From nice-to-have to prerequisite for winning

In popular culture, wind turbines often serve as a type of visual shorthand for the dream of a
sustainable future. But in the real world, sustainability considerations have evolved into strategic
drivers and enablers for our company and customers in Siemens Gamesa.
* [ Read more ][36]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]

illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# [Discover the Power of Choice]
# 

A technology platform partner for utilities worldwide, that provides scalable, interoperable,
future-proof communications, and enables grid decisions while turning data into operational
intelligence.

[Explore Your AMI Roadmap][41]

### A Modern Platform for a Modern Grid

Trilliant enables utilities to gain real-time visibility and optimize performance across an
increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.
Move from data collection to real-time grid awareness.

[Read More][43]

### Applications and Intelligence

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

### The Grid Has Changed. Now AMI Must Respond.

Traditional AMI was designed for meter reading and billing.
Today's grid must support: Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), Rapid EV adoption, Increasing
reliability and resilience demands, and Real-time operational decision-making - All while moving
from beyond infrastructure to include intelligence.

Trilliant is dedicated to providing our valued customers with the power to choose only the solutions
you need that will ensure the most successful outcomes and endpoints.
Our [Power of Choice][45] device-independent platform means you have flexibility and
interoperability.

Watch our new video to learn how Trilliant is Powering Grid Intelligence with the Power of Choice.

future-proof communications, and enables grid decisions while turning data into operational
intelligence.

[Explore Your AMI Roadmap][41]

### A Modern Platform for a Modern Grid

Trilliant enables utilities to gain real-time visibility and optimize performance across an
increasingly dynamic, distributed energy environment, from AMI to grid-edge intelligence. Across RF,
cellular, and hybrid, with a platform built for DERs, EVs, and what's next. Backed by decades of AMI
expertise and strong technology partnerships, we deliver future‑ready solutions for the evolving
energy landscape.

### Connectivity and Grid Edge

Connect every grid asset reliably and at scale.
Build a resilient, future-ready network foundation for the modern grid.

[Read More][42]

### Data and Control

Turn network data into real-time visibility and control.
Move from data collection to real-time grid awareness.

[Read More][43]

### Applications and Intelligence

Transform data into actionable grid intelligence,
Drive better outcomes across reliability, efficiency, and customer engagement as a smart utility.

[Read More][44]

### The Grid Has Changed. Now AMI Must Respond.

Traditional AMI was designed for meter reading and billing.
Today's grid must support: Distributed Energy Resources (DERs), Rapid EV adoption, Increasing
reliability and resilience demands, and Real-time operational decision-making - All while moving
from beyond infrastructure to include intelligence.

Trilliant is dedicated to providing our valued customers with the power to choose only the solutions
you need that will ensure the most successful outcomes and endpoints.
Our [Power of Choice][45] device-independent platform means you have flexibility and
interoperability.

Watch our new video to learn how Trilliant is Powering Grid Intelligence with the Power of Choice.

CSS grid generator is a tool that helps developers create custom CSS grid layouts more easily. The
generator allows users to specify the number of columns, rows, the gutter size. Made with ☕ by
[@KristjanRetter][3]

## How to use CSS grid generator?
* 1. Customize the number of columns, rows, and gaps to fit your needs.
* 2. Click the square with + sign to add a new element to the grid.
* 3. Resize the DIV using the **handle in the bottom right corner.**
* 4. Drag and drop the DIV to reposition it as desired.
* 5. Finally, copy the generated HTML and CSS code and paste it into your project.

# We map weak signals early so institutions can act before disruption lands.

Foresight systems for innovation and strategy teams to spot what's changing, surface non-obvious
patterns early, and make confident decisions.
Scan

## A new operating model for strategic intelligence.

We combine open research, AI-native execution, and structured intelligence architecture so teams can
move from signal overload to clear next moves, regardless of organization size.

Built for decision velocity

Move from scattered inputs to a first strategic map quickly, then iterate with analyst judgment
where context matters most.

Grounded in open evidence

Teams can evaluate our quality in public before commissioning custom work or long-term foresight
programs.

Designed to compound

We structure signals, metrics, and categories as reusable intelligence assets instead of one-off
slideware.

## See it. Track it. Build it.

Three ways we close the strategic intelligence gap.
[
See it
Research

Open radars on emerging technology, published in the open so you can evaluate the work before you
commission any.

][55]
[
Track it
Signals

A living intelligence platform your team monitors, queries, and builds on.

][56]
[
Build it
Build Sessions

Hands-on AI capability. We take non-technical teams from idea to working prototype in hours, and
leave the skill behind, not just the output.

][57]

Since 2025 we've trained hundreds of people to build with AI: governments, enterprises, and the
public, from complete beginners to advanced makers.

## Services

Choose how you want to work with us.
[
Done for you
I want research done for me

Signals Session: analyst-led engagement with curated outputs and interpretation, and a year of
Signals included.

][58]
[
Self-service platform ↗
I want to run research myself

Signals: our self-service platform for ongoing scanning, monitoring, and team workflows. Runs at
signals.envisioning.com.

][59]
[
Custom program
I need something custom

Bespoke Projects: bespoke intelligence programs for complex data, governance, and multi-stakeholder
contexts.

][60]
[View our services][61]

## Foresight as a system

Most organizations already use tools from every quadrant. The question is which one becomes your
operating system for strategic intelligence.
Human-Only Craft  →  Augmented Intelligence
Static Insight  →  Operational Foresight

### Insight Automation

Augmented Intelligence + Static Insight
* AI-generated reports
* Trend scraping tools
* LLM prompt wrappers
* Automated newsletters
* Dashboards without workflow integration

Shiny but disposable.

### Foresight Infrastructure

Augmented Intelligence + Operational Foresight
* Multi-model generative
* Structured assessment
* Confidence-scored
* Visualized
* Embedded into workflow

### Legacy Foresight

Human Craft + Static Insight
* Traditional foresight consultancies
* Research institutes & think tanks
* Strategy reports & academic publications

High quality, low scalability.

### Embedded Advisory

Human Craft + Operational Foresight
* Strategy consulting firms
* Corporate foresight departments
* Internal innovation labs
* Long-term advisory retainers

Effective but not adaptive at AI speed.

X: Static Insight → Operational Foresight

Y: Human-Only Craft → Augmented Intelligence

[See how services work together][62]

## Not sure where to start?

Run the readiness assessment to benchmark capability gaps before choosing a service model.
[Take the readiness assessment][63]

## Built for uncertain futures.
## Operational today.

Move from scattered signals to shared strategic intelligence that compounds over time and reduces
strategic blind spots.

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

### About HM POWER

HM POWER (Guangdong) Co., Ltd., founded in 2009, is based in Foshan – an industrial city in
Guangdong Province, China. HM POWER is committed to research and development of disruptive
technological solutions for green and smart power distribution networks as well as manufacturing of
related key equipment.

[Read More][19]

### HM POWER Products

[
[Air Insulated RMU (up to 24kV)]

### Atmospheric Pressure Sealed Nature-Air Insulated RMU/Switchgear (up to 24kV)

The Atmospheric Pressure Sealed Nature-Air Insulated RMU/Switchgear is designed to work for 40 years
in even tough environments. Since 2010, more than 40,000 of our RMUs worldwide have been running
without trouble.

][20]
[
['Zero Power Outage' Decentralized Self-Healing System Solution]

### "Zero Power Outage" Decentralized Self-Healing System Solution

A “Zero Power Outage” decentralized self-healing system consists of atmospheric sealed air insulated
RMU and smart distributed power distribution terminal.

][21]

[ [Overseas high-cold regions]

### Overseas high-cold regions

The atmospheric pressure fully sealed air insulated switchgear can be applied in high-cold regions
and provide stable performance regardless of high humidity and low temperatures.

][22]

### Aviation

Airports demand reliable power supply equipment which has appropriate sizes and can be operated
easily.

][23]
[ [Roads]

### Roads

Power supply for city roads features fixed time and power load as well as long power lines. The
distribution equipment for city road transportation should feature energy conservation and easy
maintenance.

][24]
[ [Industrial facilities]

### Industrial facilities

Industries hold the lifeline of economic growth. Some of the major equipment’s power outage will
cause considerable economic loss.

][25]
[ [Hospital & School]

### Hospital & School

Electricity supply takes 64%, or the largest proportion of energy consumption of hospitals and
schools to support the operation of lighting, elevators, air conditioners and other equipment.

][26]
[ [Real Estate]

### Real Estate

Urban residence areas usually involve commercial properties, residences, offices and other buildings
sharing a large number of sophisticated power supply equipment.

][27]

  convenience for local areas by far.

# Precision HVAC Controls & Building Automation Components

From electronic expansion valves to BMS integration modules, Honeywell delivers certified control
components engineered for commercial and industrial HVAC applications across 52 countries.

[Browse Product Catalog][8] [Request Technical Specs][9]
[HVAC Control Dashboard]

## HVAC Control Product Lines

Documented specifications and certified performance data for every component

[Thermostats and Temperature Controllers]

### Thermostats & Controllers

Programmable and communicating thermostats with PID control, multi-stage output, and BMS protocol
support for zone-level HVAC management.

[Request Datasheet][10]
[Electronic Expansion Valves]

### Electronic Expansion Valves

Stepper-motor driven EEVs with 0.1K superheat accuracy, R-290/R-744 compatibility, and rapid
response for variable-load refrigeration systems.

[Request Datasheet][11]
[Solenoid Valves]

### Solenoid Valves

Direct-acting and pilot-operated solenoid valves rated to 45 bar, with ATEX options for ammonia
systems and UL/CE dual certification.

[Request Datasheet][12]
[Pressure and Temperature Sensors]

### Pressure & Temperature Sensors

High-accuracy pressure transmitters (0.25% FS) and Pt1000 temperature probes rated -50C to +150C
with 4-20mA and Modbus output.

[Request Datasheet][13]
[VFD Controllers]

### VFD Controllers & Drives

Integrated VFD units for compressor and fan motor control, 0.75-75 kW range, with built-in PID,
RS-485 communication, and IP55 enclosure options.

[Request Datasheet][14]
[BMS Integration Modules]

### BMS Integration Modules

Protocol gateways and I/O modules supporting BACnet IP/MSTP, Modbus RTU/TCP, and LonWorks for
centralized building management system connectivity.

[Request Datasheet][15]
[View Full Product Catalog][16]

Precision control components for the most demanding HVAC and refrigeration applications

Every Honeywell expansion valve, solenoid valve, and sensor is engineered and tested for
compatibility with next-generation low-GWP refrigerants including R-290 (propane), R-744 (CO2), and
R-1234ze. As the Kigali Amendment and EU F-Gas Regulation accelerate the phase-down of high-GWP
HFCs, our control components provide the precision and safety margins required for natural
refrigerant systems.

R-290, R-744, R-1234ze valve and sensor compatibility verified across full operating range
ISO 14001 certified manufacturing processes across all 3 production facilities
VFD controllers reduce compressor energy consumption by 15-40% at partial loads

**It is an international peer-reviewed, open-access and multidisciplinary online journal published
for the enhancement of research in various disciplines of Applied Science & Engineering
Technologies.**

**

We publish original and high-quality research papers. IJRASET has many benefits all geared toward
strengthening research skills and advancing academic careers. Journal publications are a vital part
of academic career advancement. All the published papers are submitted to the major indexing
services for indexing.

IJRASET Journal is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed, UGC CARE recognized, refereed journal with
high impact factor and low publication fee. We also implemented a truly open access publication
model that provides open global access to its published material so that anyone can download and
read articles free of charge around the clock.

IJRASET relies 100% on high-quality science materials, a rigorous peer review analysis of all our
research and evaluation papers, ensuring that technology-based research is conducted across a wide
variety of engineering fields.

**Frequency:** 12 Issues per year (Monthly)

**Subject Categories:** Applied Science & Engineering Technology

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.

of academic career advancement. All the published papers are submitted to the major indexing
services for indexing.

IJRASET Journal is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed, UGC CARE recognized, refereed journal with
high impact factor and low publication fee. We also implemented a truly open access publication
model that provides open global access to its published material so that anyone can download and
read articles free of charge around the clock.

IJRASET relies 100% on high-quality science materials, a rigorous peer review analysis of all our
research and evaluation papers, ensuring that technology-based research is conducted across a wide
variety of engineering fields.

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.

## About IJSGCE

[Current issue][21][Forth coming issue][22]
**International Journal of Smart Grid and Clean Energy (IJSGCE)**

*IJSGCE* is focused on new and innovative integration and deployment of smart grid and clean energy
technologies that can lower energy cost for consumers, achieve energy independence and reduce
greenhouse emissions. The journal will publish original research on theories, technologies, design,
policies, and implementation of smart grid and clean energy technologies. All papers will be blind
reviewed and accepted papers will be published quarterly. ([open access][23])

Please submit your paper via [Online Submission System][24].

##### Northern Islands, Sri Lanka][26]

##### Turbines][27]

###### Jiangfeng Zhu*, Qian Zhao

##### 04[Two-Stage Optimal Allocation and Operation of Hybrid PV-BESS Systems Considering
##### Critical/Sensitive Loads in Distribution Networks: A Case Study on the 117-Bus Mazar-e-Sharif
##### Network, Afghanistan][28]

###### Abdul Farooq Bikzada*, Saeid Esmaeili, Sina Shakeri, Mohammad Jawad Rasa

##### Review on Forecasting, Optimization, and Coordination Frameworks][29]

###### Md Rayhan Tanvir

##### 06[Voltage and Reactive Power Control in Distribution Networks Based on the Optimal Allocation
##### of Photovoltaic Systems: Case Study Mazar-e-Sharif Distribution Network][30]

###### Abdul Farooq Bikzada*, Saeid Esmaeili, Sina Shakeri

[More Latest Articles][31]

##### Systems][33]

###### Qi Zhang, Mingyan Jiang*, Keqin Jiang

###### Tawatchai Kraisee, Pilin Hankhuntod, Niwat Ketchat, Bundit Krittacom*

###### Andrea Alberizzi*, Alessandro Zani, Paolo Di Barba

[More Featured Articles][36]

## AI Based Predictive Maintenance

Nanoprecise’s AI Based Predictive Maintenance solutions drive mechanical and operational
efficiencies that increase production and safety while reducing carbon footprints.

[Learn More][44]

### Prescriptive Maintenance

Empowering your maintenance team with actionable insights on where and how to spend their time.

We help teams digitize intelligently, filtering noise while delivering visibility without overload,
so you can focus on what matters.

[LEARN MORE][46]

### The MachineDoctor Sensor

The 6-in-1 machine health sensor monitoring the most available data possible on the health of your
equipment.

[LEARN MORE][47]

## WHY NANOPRECISE?
* [Unmatched Cybersecurity][48]
* [Energy Conscious][49]
* [Scalable Connectivity][50]
* [Ease of Deployment][51]

### Unmatched Cybersecurity

We respect the privacy and security of your data and have custom-built our solutions with it in
mind. From collection to transmission to storage, our SOC 2 Type 2 compliant layered approach
ensures true peace of mind.  

### Energy Conscious

We are proud to be moving beyond Predictive Maintenance and making a shift to caring for the
environment and your organizations role in protecting it. Our Energy-Centric [Predictive Maintenance
solutions][52] drive productivity, efficiencies and profits.

### Scalable Connectivity

One of the most important parts of IoT monitoring is ensuring repeatable, secure connectivity. We’ve
designed our sensors for scalable, cellular or WiFi connectivity, delivering ease of deployment and
consistent transmission.

### Ease of Deployment

The design of our sensors and their scalable connectivity ensures they can be easily deployed within
a multitude of environments directly onto equipment.

## Let us show you how!

Explore the transformative potential of [predictive maintenance][53]. At Nanoprecise, we specialize
in tailoring predictive maintenance to your unique needs. Reach out today, and together, let’s pave
the way for a more efficient, profitable and sustainable future.

## AI Based Predictive Maintenance

Nanoprecise’s AI Based Predictive Maintenance solutions drive mechanical and operational
efficiencies that increase production and safety while reducing carbon footprints.

[Learn More][44]

### Prescriptive Maintenance

Empowering your maintenance team with actionable insights on where and how to spend their time.

[LEARN MORE][45]
[Digitize without noise]

### **Digitize Without Confusion**

We help teams digitize intelligently, filtering noise while delivering visibility without overload,
so you can focus on what matters.

[LEARN MORE][46]

### The MachineDoctor Sensor

The 6-in-1 machine health sensor monitoring the most available data possible on the health of your
equipment.

[LEARN MORE][47]

## WHY NANOPRECISE?
* [Unmatched Cybersecurity][48]
* [Energy Conscious][49]
* [Scalable Connectivity][50]
* [Ease of Deployment][51]

### Unmatched Cybersecurity

We respect the privacy and security of your data and have custom-built our solutions with it in
mind. From collection to transmission to storage, our SOC 2 Type 2 compliant layered approach
ensures true peace of mind.  

### Energy Conscious

We are proud to be moving beyond Predictive Maintenance and making a shift to caring for the
environment and your organizations role in protecting it. Our Energy-Centric [Predictive Maintenance
solutions][52] drive productivity, efficiencies and profits.

### Scalable Connectivity

One of the most important parts of IoT monitoring is ensuring repeatable, secure connectivity. We’ve
designed our sensors for scalable, cellular or WiFi connectivity, delivering ease of deployment and
consistent transmission.

### Ease of Deployment

The design of our sensors and their scalable connectivity ensures they can be easily deployed within
a multitude of environments directly onto equipment.

## Let us show you how!

Explore the transformative potential of [predictive maintenance][53]. At Nanoprecise, we specialize
in tailoring predictive maintenance to your unique needs. Reach out today, and together, let’s pave
the way for a more efficient, profitable and sustainable future.

### Distribution Resiliency Solutions

Osmose life extension programs preserve strength that is initially built into wood utility poles.
Pole evaluation and application of remedial treatment saves money by adding many additional years of
durable service life. Osmose pole restoration systems are designed to restore strength to poles that
do not meet structural requirements due to decay or damage at a fraction of a new pole replacement
cost.

Osmose [structural resiliency^{®}][124] solutions strengthen and harden wood poles before nature’s
fury strikes. Using predictive analytics, innovative data collection, our pole loading expertise and
software, and family of trussing systems, our innovative and targeted resiliency program is five
times faster and often times 70% less than a replacement-only program.

[ LEARN MORE ][125]

### Transmission Resiliency Solutions

Osmose is the nation’s leading provider of steel asset assessment and resiliency solutions. We are a
trusted partner ensuring your transmission structures get the right action at the right time in
order to help withstand severe weather, fires, and harsh environments.

Osmose solutions include corrosion prediction, structure evaluation and analysis, and restoration
and upgrade design to extend useful life and increase the capacity of steel assets. With data
collected through our field assessment leveraging our exclusive field analysis program and our
proprietary resiliency modeling software, Osmose implements simple and complex [restoration and
upgrade solutions][126] for electric utilities. Many of these services can be capitalized to avoid
unnecessary O&M spending.

# Announcing the Relocation of our West Coast Headquarters to Ohio

Resilience announces the relocation of its corporate headquarters from San Diego, California to Blue
Ash, Ohio, a northern suburb of Cincinnati, and expansion of its sterile manufacturing
capabilities. 

[Read the Press Release][61]
[Resilience key art graphic]

## Nothing in this industry ever stays the same. So we've evolved too.

We've expanded our strengths while keeping quality, speed, and sustainability front and center to
build a more resilient tomorrow, today. Resilience is bringing together brilliant minds in science
and engineering with access to advanced technologies and right-first-time performance at scale.

## Facilities

Resilience is North America based, with facilities across the continental US and Canada. Our
regulatory expertise spans across global markets and serves customers in the EU, Asia, the Middle
East, and North America.

[ See our sites [resi-arrow-white] ][62]

## Custom solutions to fit your needs

We were founded with a straightforward yet bold purpose: to broaden access to complex medicines and
to protect biopharmaceutical supply chains against disruption. At the heart of our approach is a
network of high-tech, end-to-end drug substance and drug product manufacturing solutions that can
help ensure the medicines of today and tomorrow can be made quickly, safely, sustainably, and at
scale.

[Large Molecule Biologics Development & Manufacturing][63]
[Cell Therapy Development & Manufacturing][64]
[Aseptic Drug Product Manufacturing][65]
[Device Assembly, Packaging & Logistics][66]

*Photo captured in aseptic training environment.

## Earning Trust One Dose at a Time

Our dedication to quality drives everything we do. Our unwavering commitment comes to life
through the delivery of more than 100 million vials and pre-filled syringes each year.

### Commercial readiness

100% pass rate for third-party and EU Annex 1 assessments.

# Announcing the Relocation of our West Coast Headquarters to Ohio

Resilience announces the relocation of its corporate headquarters from San Diego, California to Blue
Ash, Ohio, a northern suburb of Cincinnati, and expansion of its sterile manufacturing
capabilities. 

[Read the Press Release][61]
[Resilience key art graphic]

## Nothing in this industry ever stays the same. So we've evolved too.

We've expanded our strengths while keeping quality, speed, and sustainability front and center to
build a more resilient tomorrow, today. Resilience is bringing together brilliant minds in science
and engineering with access to advanced technologies and right-first-time performance at scale.

## Facilities

Resilience is North America based, with facilities across the continental US and Canada. Our
regulatory expertise spans across global markets and serves customers in the EU, Asia, the Middle
East, and North America.

[ See our sites [resi-arrow-white] ][62]

## Custom solutions to fit your needs

We were founded with a straightforward yet bold purpose: to broaden access to complex medicines and
to protect biopharmaceutical supply chains against disruption. At the heart of our approach is a
network of high-tech, end-to-end drug substance and drug product manufacturing solutions that can
help ensure the medicines of today and tomorrow can be made quickly, safely, sustainably, and at
scale.

[Large Molecule Biologics Development & Manufacturing][63]
[Cell Therapy Development & Manufacturing][64]
[Aseptic Drug Product Manufacturing][65]
[Device Assembly, Packaging & Logistics][66]

*Photo captured in aseptic training environment.

## Earning Trust One Dose at a Time

Our dedication to quality drives everything we do. Our unwavering commitment comes to life
through the delivery of more than 100 million vials and pre-filled syringes each year.

### Commercial readiness

100% pass rate for third-party and EU Annex 1 assessments.

### Successful inspections

USFDA cGMP
USFDA PAI
USFDA PFS & Vial Approval
Health Canada
EMA Virtual Inspection

### About Conference



Conference series LLC invites all the participants from all over the world to attend “**World
Congress on ****Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies”** during September 24-25, 2018 in
UAE, Dubai which includes prompt keynote presentations, Oral talks, Poster presentations and
Exhibitions. [Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies Congress 2018 ][80]is a thick, black
to yellow, a substantial foundation for the future usage has been established by the Smart Grids
which are electrical grids has a variety of operational and energy measures including smart meters,
smart appliances, renewable energy resources, and energy efficient resources. Electronic power
conditioning and control of the production and distribution of electricity are important aspects of
the smart grid. Renewable energy is energy that is collected from renewable resources, which are
naturally replenished on a human timescale, such as sunlight, wind, rain, tides, waves, and
geothermal heat. The studies are more concerned to Power Energy, Power plants, Electricity, Energy
Economics, Renewable Energy. Advanced studies are being made to improvise developments in
Sustainability, Smart Buildings and Cities, Renewable Energies, Fossil Fuel and Biofuels, Power and
Energy products and their uses, Computer Applications in grid coding, Cyber Security of power grid
and Renewable Energy Business and many more.

**Importance and Scope:**

Over the past few years, global economic activities have increased a lot. This tremendous growth has
raised serious problems about current important patterns of production and consumption. With members
from around the world focused on learning about power grids, renewable energies and its advances;
this is the best opportunity to reach the largest assemblage of participants from the electrical
power and energy community. Conduct presentations, distribute information, meet with current and
potential scientists, make a splash with new researches and its developments, and receive name
recognition at Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies congress conference. World-renowned
speakers, the most recent techniques, developments and the newest updates in power and energy
industry are hallmarks of this conference.

**Why to attend?**

Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies Congress 2018 offers a fantastic opportunity to meet
and make new contacts in the field of power energy, renewable energies and solar power by providing
collaboration spaces and break-out rooms with tea and lunch for delegates between sessions with
invaluable networking time for you. It allows delegates to have issues addressed on Power and Energy
by recognized global experts who are up to date with the latest developments in the Smart Grid and
Renewable Energy field and provide information on new techniques and technologies. This
International Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies conference will feature renowned
keynote speakers, plenary speeches, young research forum, poster presentations, technical workshops
and career guidance sessions.

**Target Audience:**
* Smart Grid industries
* Electrical Engineering Colleges
* Chemical and Electrical engineering companies
* Renewable and Solar companies
* Power and Energy Students, Scientists
* Smart Grids, Solar and Renewable energy Researchers
* Electrical and Chemical Faculty
* Power and Energy Associations and Societies
* Business Entrepreneurs
* Training Institutes
* Software developing companies
* Data Management Companies
* Manufacturing Companies

### Sessions/Tracks


**Track 1: **[**Smart grids / E-Energy**][81]

Smart grid is the unified combination of technologies such as IT, telecommunication and
[electrical][82] and processes into [transmission][83] and distribution networks and smart meters
for the consumers to accomplish objective of economic and reliable production, transportation and
consumption of electricity. Smart Grids are two-way communication technology. At the beginning, 
smart grid technology used on [electricity networks][84], which is generated from  the [power
plants][85] and [wind farms][86] all the way is used by the consumers of electricity.  It helps us
in facilitating real-time troubleshooting problems.

Related [Power Grid Conferences][87] | [Renewable Energy Conferences][88] | [Solar Energy
Conferences][89] | [Power Energy Conferences][90]

[Conventional][91] and [Sustainable Energies][92] March 30-31, 2018 Orlando, Florida, USA;
[Wireless, Telecommunication][93] & [IoT][94] May 28-29, 2018 London, UK; [Power][95] and [Energy
Engineering][96] June 18-19, 2018 Rome, Italy; [Biofuels][97] and [Bioenergy][98], April 16-17, 2018
Dubai, UAE; 20th International Conference on [Smart Grid][99] and [Clean Energy Technologies][100]
San Francisco, USA June 6 - 7, 2018; 2nd EAI International Conference on [Smart Grid][101] and
[Internet of Things][102] (SGIoT 2018) JULY 11–13, 2018, NIAGARA FALLS, CANADA; 3rd EAI
International Conference on [Smart Grid][103] and [Innovative Frontiers in Telecommunications][104]
APRIL 23–25, 2018 | AUCKLAND, NEW ZEALAND; Eighth International Conference on [Smart Grids, Green
Communications][105] and [IT Energy-aware Technologies ENERGY][106] 2018 May 20, 2018 to May 24,
2018 - Nice, France

[Global Smart Grid Federation][107], [Korea Smart Grid Association][108], [Energy Networks
Association][109], [Smart Electric Power Alliance][110]

**Track 2:** [**Power engineering**][111]

As Power engineering is a subfield of [electrical engineering][112] deals with the generation,
transmission, distribution and utilization of electric power from [grids][113]. Electrical power
starts flowing from the power plant which consists of a spinning electrical generator. The
[alternating currents][114] (AC) in power plant are more advantageous than [direct currents][115]
(DC) as the transformers must compulsorily should possess alternating currents to operate and the
power from power distribution grid depends on transformers. The [three-phase][116] power from
generator enters a transmission substation at the power plant which has large transformers to
convert the generator voltage to extremely high voltages for long-distance transmission on the
[transmission grid][117].

Technology][125] September, 10-11, 2018 London, UK; [Green Energy][126] June 14-16, 2018 London, UK;
[Renewable Energy][127] and [Resources][128], August 27-28, 2018, Boston, USA; 2018 International
Conference on [Smart Grid][129] and [Clean Energy Technologies][130] (ICSGCE), 29 May to 01 Jun
2018, Malaysia; International Conference on [Renewable Energy][131] and [Smart Grid][132], 22-24 Mar
2018, Kitakyushu, Japan; [GRAND RENEWABLE ENERGY][133] 2018 International Conference and Exhibiton,
June 17-22, 2018, Pacifico Yokohoma, Japan; [Technologies][134] and [Materials for Renewable Energy,
Environment and Sustainability][135], Beirut, Lebanon, February 1-3, 2018

[Taiwan Smart Grid Industry Association][136], [Canadian Electricity Association][137], [National
Electrical Manufacturers Association][138], [American Public Power Association][139]

**Track 3: **[**Grid Energy Storage (or) Batteries**][140]

Grid energy storage which is large-scale energy storage is a collection of methods used to store
electrical energy on a large scale within an electrical [power grid][141]. Electrical energy is
stored during times when production especially from intermittent power plants such as
[renewable][142] electricity sources such as [wind power][143], [tidal power][144], and [solar
power][145] exceeds consumption, and returned to the grid when production falls below consumption.
The battery system could be used to run the load without starting the engine or when the wind is
unavailable. In future, less expensive batteries could play an important role on the electrical
grid.

### About Conference



Conference series LLC invites all the participants from all over the world to attend “**World
Congress on ****Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies”** during September 24-25, 2018 in
UAE, Dubai which includes prompt keynote presentations, Oral talks, Poster presentations and
Exhibitions. [Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies Congress 2018 ][80]is a thick, black
to yellow, a substantial foundation for the future usage has been established by the Smart Grids
which are electrical grids has a variety of operational and energy measures including smart meters,
smart appliances, renewable energy resources, and energy efficient resources. Electronic power
conditioning and control of the production and distribution of electricity are important aspects of
the smart grid. Renewable energy is energy that is collected from renewable resources, which are
naturally replenished on a human timescale, such as sunlight, wind, rain, tides, waves, and
geothermal heat. The studies are more concerned to Power Energy, Power plants, Electricity, Energy
Economics, Renewable Energy. Advanced studies are being made to improvise developments in
Sustainability, Smart Buildings and Cities, Renewable Energies, Fossil Fuel and Biofuels, Power and
Energy products and their uses, Computer Applications in grid coding, Cyber Security of power grid
and Renewable Energy Business and many more.

**Importance and Scope:**

Over the past few years, global economic activities have increased a lot. This tremendous growth has
raised serious problems about current important patterns of production and consumption. With members
from around the world focused on learning about power grids, renewable energies and its advances;
this is the best opportunity to reach the largest assemblage of participants from the electrical
power and energy community. Conduct presentations, distribute information, meet with current and
potential scientists, make a splash with new researches and its developments, and receive name
recognition at Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies congress conference. World-renowned
speakers, the most recent techniques, developments and the newest updates in power and energy
industry are hallmarks of this conference.

**Why to attend?**

Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies Congress 2018 offers a fantastic opportunity to meet
and make new contacts in the field of power energy, renewable energies and solar power by providing
collaboration spaces and break-out rooms with tea and lunch for delegates between sessions with
invaluable networking time for you. It allows delegates to have issues addressed on Power and Energy
by recognized global experts who are up to date with the latest developments in the Smart Grid and
Renewable Energy field and provide information on new techniques and technologies. This
International Smart grids, Solar Power and Renewable Energies conference will feature renowned
keynote speakers, plenary speeches, young research forum, poster presentations, technical workshops
and career guidance sessions.

**Target Audience:**
* Smart Grid industries
* Electrical Engineering Colleges
* Chemical and Electrical engineering companies
* Renewable and Solar companies
* Power and Energy Students, Scientists
* Smart Grids, Solar and Renewable energy Researchers
* Electrical and Chemical Faculty
* Power and Energy Associations and Societies
* Business Entrepreneurs
* Training Institutes
* Software developing companies
* Data Management Companies
* Manufacturing Companies

### Sessions/Tracks


**Track 1: **[**Smart grids / E-Energy**][81]

Smart grid is the unified combination of technologies such as IT, telecommunication and
[electrical][82] and processes into [transmission][83] and distribution networks and smart meters
for the consumers to accomplish objective of economic and reliable production, transportation and
consumption of electricity. Smart Grids are two-way communication technology. At the beginning, 
smart grid technology used on [electricity networks][84], which is generated from  the [power
plants][85] and [wind farms][86] all the way is used by the consumers of electricity.  It helps us
in facilitating real-time troubleshooting problems.

[Global Smart Grid Federation][107], [Korea Smart Grid Association][108], [Energy Networks

**Track 2:** [**Power engineering**][111]

As Power engineering is a subfield of [electrical engineering][112] deals with the generation,
transmission, distribution and utilization of electric power from [grids][113]. Electrical power
starts flowing from the power plant which consists of a spinning electrical generator. The
[alternating currents][114] (AC) in power plant are more advantageous than [direct currents][115]
(DC) as the transformers must compulsorily should possess alternating currents to operate and the
power from power distribution grid depends on transformers. The [three-phase][116] power from
generator enters a transmission substation at the power plant which has large transformers to
convert the generator voltage to extremely high voltages for long-distance transmission on the
[transmission grid][117].

June 17-22, 2018, Pacifico Yokohoma, Japan; [Technologies][134] and [Materials for Renewable Energy,
Environment and Sustainability][135], Beirut, Lebanon, February 1-3, 2018

[Taiwan Smart Grid Industry Association][136], [Canadian Electricity Association][137], [National
Electrical Manufacturers Association][138], [American Public Power Association][139]

**Track 3: **[**Grid Energy Storage (or) Batteries**][140]

Grid energy storage which is large-scale energy storage is a collection of methods used to store
electrical energy on a large scale within an electrical [power grid][141]. Electrical energy is
stored during times when production especially from intermittent power plants such as
[renewable][142] electricity sources such as [wind power][143], [tidal power][144], and [solar
power][145] exceeds consumption, and returned to the grid when production falls below consumption.
The battery system could be used to run the load without starting the engine or when the wind is
unavailable. In future, less expensive batteries could play an important role on the electrical
grid.

## How Our Grid Maker Elevates Your Artistic Process

Professional-quality grid drawing tools, completely free, directly in your browser.

### Perfect Proportions

Divide your canvas into precise sections to capture accurate proportions in portraits, landscapes,
and complex compositions.

### Scale with Precision

Transfer images from one size to another while maintaining perfect proportions - ideal for murals or
miniatures.

### Customizable Grids

Adjust grid size, line thickness, colors, and opacity to match your artistic style and medium.

### Easy Export Options

Download your custom grid as PNG or JPG - ready to print or use digitally in any software.

### Reference Image Overlay

Upload reference photos and overlay your grid directly on them for accurate transfer to your canvas.

### Cell Labels

Optional A1-style cell labeling helps you track which section you are working on - perfect for the
grid method.

## Get Started in 3 Easy Steps

1

### Upload Your Reference Image

Drag and drop your reference photo onto the grid maker, or click the upload button to browse your
files. We support JPG, PNG, GIF, and WEBP formats.

2

### Customize Your Grid

Adjust the number of rows and columns, line color, line thickness, and opacity to match your needs.
Toggle cell labels on or off for easier reference.

3

### Download Your Grid

Click Download PNG or Download JPG to save your gridded image. Print it out or use it digitally
alongside your drawing surface.

## Who Uses Grid Drawing?

The grid method is a universal drawing technique used across skill levels and mediums.

### Beginners

Master proportions and gain confidence tackling complex subjects

### Students

Practice accuracy and develop observational skills in art classes

### Teachers

Create custom grid worksheets and demonstrations for art classes

### Professional Artists

Save time on preliminary layout work for commissioned pieces

### Illustrators

Transfer and scale concepts precisely for client work

Scale designs from small sketches to wall-sized masterpieces

# Welcome to Webone.one

Your **Intelligent Web** Starts Here.

One place. Every journey.

## What is Webone.one?

Webone.one is an intelligent web app curator that orchestrates relevant apps to end users through
enhanced filtering and machine learning search via sweeping through the globe. Think VPN, then think
Chat GPT, then think Google for web apps.

Our platform helps you discover, launch, and grow smarter with carefully curated web applications
from around the world. We use the **1EO trust framework** to evaluate and rank apps based on
quality, relevance, and trustworthiness.

## Key Features
* **Intelligent Search:** Powered by machine learning to find the perfect apps for your needs
* **Enhanced Filtering:** Filter by category, region, and persona to discover exactly what you need
* **1EO Trust Framework:** Quality assurance through transparent evaluation metrics
* **52 Unique Personas:** Match apps to your specific personality and use case
* **Free and Pro Tiers:** Choose the plan that fits your needs
* **Global Coverage:** Discover apps from around the world

## How It Works

Webone.one uses advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze and categorize web applications. Our
1EO framework evaluates apps based on:
* **Origin:** Where the app is from and its regional context
* **Relevance:** How well it matches your search intent and persona
* **Discoverability:** How easy it is to find and use
* **Trust:** Quality signals and user feedback

## Get Started

Ready to discover your next favorite web app? Start exploring our curated collection today.
* [Learn More][1]
* [Get Started][2]
* [Explore Apps][3]

© 2026 Webone.one - Your Intelligent Web Starts Here

[3]: /dashboard
